plain_english_policy: Shifting Medicaid beneficiaries from traditional fee-for-service to managed care systems

effects.rationale: Managed care is a private-sector delivery mechanism for Medicaid services.
Reducing traditional Medicaid benefits or eligibility (implied by consolidation into managed care) may restrict access to some services, even if the overall program remains in place.
Managed care often imposes utilization controls (e.g., prior authorization) that can limit access to services compared to fee-for-service.
